title: SWF: DefineMorphShape (tag 46) encoding
description: Test that a layer with shape tween (tweenType='shape') between two keyframes produces DefineMorphShape (tag 46) in exported SWF. Verify: (1) tag 46 appears, (2) body has valid start/end shape record structure (first 4 bytes are character ID UI16 + ratio UI16), (3) no DefineMorphShape for motion tweens or no-tween layers. Check compile.ts to see if DefineMorphShape is currently implemented.
